prompt: Create an original 90 second melodic chiptune instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: pulse-wave lead, triangle bass, noise percussion. Style: clear arpeggiated game-like melody and concise rhythmic phrases. Tempo approximately 140 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: An energetic, retro-inspired electronic track featuring driving synth melodies, arpeggios, and a strong electronic drum beat. It evokes a chiptune or arcade game aesthetic.
description.zh: 一首充满活力的复古电子音乐，以驱动性的合成器旋律、琶音和强劲的电子鼓点为特色。它唤起了芯片音乐或街机游戏的风格。
